architectures.A: strict issuer assumed; one authority-signed compact permit and minimal command at execution
architectures.B: current-style full-artifact executor; permit + proposal + signed policy + evidence + decision + state
architectures.C: compact permit + one independently keyed witness attestation over upstream commitments + minimal command

authority_key_compromise_probe.B: accepted when supplied matching tampered full evidence; current-style executor re-hashes but does not independently re-verify evidence signatures
authority_key_compromise_probe.C: blocked because independent witness commitment remained pinned to the original evidence root
authority_key_compromise_probe.scenario: authority key can re-sign a permit whose evidence root matches tampered evidence; witness key remains honest

environmental_measurement.energy: not measured; cpu_us_per_op is only a compute-time proxy
